content.title: About
content.content: Quinoa puffed is a light, airy snack made from whole quinoa grains that have been puffed. It retains all the nutritional benefits of quinoa while offering a crunchy texture and a pleasant nutty flavor. Ideal for quick snacking, adding to granola, yogurt, or baked goods.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Quinoa is an ancient grain native to the Andes, cultivated for over 5,000 years.
Puffed quinoa is naturally gluten‑free, making it suitable for gluten‑free diets.
Quinoa is a complete protein, containing all nine essential amino acids.
Compared to most grains, quinoa has higher levels of iron and magnesium.
Puffed quinoa is easily digestible and provides rapid energy, popular among athletes.

items.title: Rich source of protein
items.content: Quinoa provides about 14 % protein, supporting muscle maintenance and satiety.

items.title: High in dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber aids digestion and helps maintain stable blood sugar levels.

items.title: Mineral powerhouse
items.content: Contains magnesium, iron, zinc, and phosphorus, essential for bones, nerves, and energy metabolism.

items.title: Antioxidant properties
items.content: Phytonutrients such as quercetin and kaempferol help protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Supports cardiovascular health
items.content: Monounsaturated fats and antioxidants contribute to a healthy heart.

items.title: Quinoa allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to quinoa, ranging from skin rashes to respiratory issues.

items.title: Oxalate content
items.content: Quinoa contains oxalates, which in excess can contribute to kidney stone formation.

items.title: Digestive sensitivity
items.content: Large portions may cause bloating or gas due to its high fiber content.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Puffed quinoa can be enjoyed as a standalone snack, mixed into granola, yogurt, smoothie bowls, used in baking, or as a crunchy topping for salads.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store puffed quinoa in an airtight container in a cool, dry, dark place. For longer shelf life, keep it in the refrigerator to prevent fat oxidation.
